rss: Stock up on food to prepare for extreme weather, minister says
title: Get Ready for Rainy Days!
story: The weather is getting rainy and stormy! Some grown-ups say we should get extra cereal and juice just in case. What do you think your family should do?
storyBig: With extreme weather events on the horizon, experts are advising families to stock up on essential goods like cereal and juice. The anticipation of these weather patterns could lead to temporary shortages in grocery stores.
think: How do you think buying extra cereal and juice helps families during storms?
bull: It's smart to be prepared for anything!
bear: If too many people buy extra, stores might run out quickly.

rss: Prosecco, cakes and beauty products - how to get birthday freebies and why there's a catch
title: Birthday Surprises from Companies!
story: Some companies give out surprises like free chocolate on your birthday! But you might have to sign up first. Would you like a birthday treat from your favorite candy shop?
storyBig: Companies often offer birthday freebies, such as chocolates, to entice customers to sign up for their loyalty programs. While this strategy can drive customer engagement, it's important to understand the marketing tactics involved.
think: Why do you think companies give away free treats on your birthday?
bull: Free treats make birthdays extra special!
bear: Remember, you may need to share some personal info to get the freebies.
